verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents a Slack integration that watches channels for @openhands mentions, opens an agent conversation with the message context, and replies in Slack when the agent finishes. That covers tagging an agent in a chat thread to delegate a task. The evidence suggests this is an automation or channel-monitor template rather than a built-in chat bot, and it says little about ongoing back-and-forth. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-turn discussion inside the thread, detailed setup docs for the Slack mention flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
